transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because of my husband's sister. She’s been working this whole family business just so she can get control of the money and push me right out of any decisions. And, you know, no matter how folks try to smooth it over or tell me I'm wrong, I know what I’ve been seeing. I've been watching her do this for more than a year now.
Have you ever heard voices, whispers, or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or... whispers or anything like that. I just hear what people are actually saying out loud.
